exposure: Women who did and did not undergo ECV
cohort: 215 women with singleton gestation and noncephalic presentation at > 37.0 weeks
finding: Women without a prior vaginal delivery were significantly less likely to undergo attempted ECV, highlighting a potential disparity in access to this procedure.
mod_finding: Women with a prior vaginal delivery were significantly more likely to undergo attempted external cephalic version for fetal malpresentation at term.
